symptom: Opening a spa package deep link with date and package query parameters intermittently left a blank page or waited more than 30 seconds before content appeared.
expected_behavior: The dated spa package deep link should render the place immediately, preserve the selected date and package, and scroll to the requested package without exposing a blank document.
environment: Public VII production at vii.spaplus.co on 2026-11-12, app build 45e4aff9-4463-da1a-8c3e-fe9813c34625 and final Edge worker version 3b186fdd-e4ef-41e6-923f-c4908bbdfb24.

steps: Open https://vii.spaplus.co/discover/place/spa-25?date=2026-11-13&package=4193#spa-package-4193 in a cold browser session.
Observe the document while the deep link waits for the origin response and package hydration.
reproduction.evidence: The pre-fix Playwright reproduction exceeded the 30 second DOMContentLoaded timeout, and public Edge headers showed the dated package request was not served by the fast document cache.

observations.observation: The date and package query keys were absent from the public document cache allowlist.
observations.evidence: Inspection of services/vii-edge-delivery/src/index.ts and worker/public-response-cache.ts showed neither query key was admitted before the repair.

observations.observation: The same place document hydrated the requested date and package correctly when delivered under the original deep-link URL.
observations.evidence: .qa-output/spa-canonical-document-substitution.mjs preserved the URL, displayed 13 בנובמבר 2026, found spa-package-4193, and reported no hydration or console errors.

observations.observation: The final public Edge route now serves dated package documents from cache.
observations.evidence: Fresh dated variants returned X-VII-Edge-Delivery: HIT with measured totals of 0.434932 seconds and 0.453180 seconds.

hypotheses.mechanism: Dated spa package links bypassed the public document cache, forcing a slow origin render and exposing an empty page during the wait.
hypotheses.prediction: The exact deep link will miss or bypass Edge while an equivalent canonical place document can render the same package state quickly after hydration.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare cache classification for the exact query and run canonical-document substitution while preserving the browser URL.
hypotheses.result: The exact query bypassed cache before repair, while canonical substitution preserved the selected date and package without hydration errors.

hypotheses.mechanism: A client JavaScript exception or missing package record prevented the spa page from rendering.
hypotheses.prediction: The page would remain broken after receiving canonical HTML, with console errors or no spa-package-4193 target.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Load the deep link with canonical HTML and inspect console errors, page title, heading, selected date, and package target.
hypotheses.result: The page rendered the correct title and heading, displayed the requested date, found the package target, and produced no client exception.

fix.change: Admit validated spa date and package queries, reuse the canonical place HTML cache identity for ordinary documents, retain full query identity for Flight responses, and exclude booking or private state.
fix.evidence: Before repair the exact route timed out beyond 30 seconds; after Edge version 3b186fdd-e4ef-41e6-923f-c4908bbdfb24 it rendered visibly in 1194 ms on mobile and 2225 ms on desktop, with repeat document responses served as HIT.

affected_family: Public spa place deep links containing validated date and package query parameters
Next.js Flight responses for spa place routes that must retain router query identity
Booking, session, preview, and other private query states that must remain excluded from shared cache

regression_checks.evidence: Status 200, commit 364 ms, DOMContentLoaded 1830 ms, first visible content 2225 ms, correct H1, package target present, and scrollY 1284.

regression_checks.check: Exact production spa package deep link on iPhone 13 viewport
regression_checks.evidence: Status 200, commit 293 ms, DOMContentLoaded 1014 ms, first visible content 1194 ms, FCP 1028 ms, package target present, and zero request failures.

regression_checks.check: Edge cache and query safety automated suite
regression_checks.evidence: The final Edge test run completed 93 tests with zero failures, including canonical HTML reuse, Flight separation, and private-state exclusions.

regression_checks.check: Rendered production destination through in-app browser
regression_checks.evidence: The exact URL displayed Titanic Spa content, package navigation, interactive map, footer, and the requested production title instead of a blank page.

remaining_unknowns: A previously observed map-snapshot fallback request returned 404 on one desktop run, but the interactive map loaded and this request was not causal to the blank-page incident.
authorization_boundary: Adir explicitly requested an urgent public repair and publication for the observed VII loading failure; changes were limited to safe cache routing, tests, and deployment evidence.
